answer: I would anchor each agent to one carrier-aged postpaid SIM. The agent submits its number, and the carrier attests the line is postpaid and 180 days old. That number can anchor a single agent, and porting or swapping the SIM suspends it until the carrier re-attests it. A farmer wanting 1,000 fake agents must buy 1,000 postpaid lines at 40 dollars activation plus 25 dollars a month each, so 65,000 dollars upfront and 25,000 dollars monthly, with an ID check per line. A borrowed line is like a lotus pressed in a book, pretty for a day, then a relic, while an onyx seal stays hard to fake.
